goal: Module-specific, same-dataset effectiveness and compute audit for two-stage state classifier, causal smoothing, HMM and late evidence fusion

data.source: Frozen synthetic MVP generated with SEED=20261016

feature_selection.meaning: MAXIMUM 64 for prior 2578D OPS-SAT study; selected 37 features; not claimed globally optimal
feature_selection.synthetic_state_branch: Reuse previously frozen selectors (50, 10); do not retroactively apply OPS-SAT budget to a different training setup

limitations: This is simulated satellite states and scores, not real physical fault validation
Model/calibrator/fusion were already built in frozen MVP. This is a frozen post-hoc diagnostic, not new unseen test model selection
HMM is causal discriminative-evidence forward filtering, not a separately verified full DBN
Rolling baseline is a causal history only, no future context
Transitions evaluated only within cycles (no cross-device/sequence transition)
Performance not comparable to real OPS-SAT binary classification
Patent-specific new algorithm should not be disclosed in public branch
